fast_edge_assumptions.interpretation: A propagation scale only, not extracted impedance, crosstalk or overshoot bound. The new RX trace is electrically relevant for a.5ns edge; probe actual receiver waveforms and simultaneous aggressors. Direct coupling and return inductance need actual source impedance/loading for a defensible voltage bound.

C3.disposition: Direct100nF-to-MCU supply and ground paths remain exact and well separated. The two lower-margin feed-track projections remain fully supported. The restricted provisional-band exception is reasonable for this candidate; fresh DC checks actual feed/current consequences.

FLASH_CS_bypass.disposition: A continuous short bypass and full offset loop join the real U14 ground annulus. The checked exit is slightly above the existing .127mm signal-width design reference; do not label it an exact .150mm native neck everywhere or a fabrication-tolerance guarantee.

TP2.disposition: Finite connected GND beyond the whole pad; the approximately one-dielectric pad collar is a reasonable prototype geometry. It is not an enforced trace-width rule or extracted impedance guarantee.

U15_J11.disposition: Full finite inward ground approach and both annular attachments survive. A smaller outward all-direction radial collar alone does not require a new geometry change or prove ESD immunity.

prospective_MOSI_combination.smallest_ranked_improvement: Screen one GND stitch on the left of the RX slot outside the actual U2 via keepout, using existing right-side ground contacts to serve MOSI and the nearby B_RX/B_TX crossings jointly. No coordinate or final improvement is presumed qualified.
prospective_MOSI_combination.specific_new_issue: A planned B MOSI launch crosses the RX slot for.384528406mm.
